verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs say agents get real-time access to customer systems through scoped, short-lived JWT tokens. Its integrations let the agent retrieve data and take actions across chat, email and voice with no custom code. Browser Actions covers systems without an integration, and conversation history carries across sessions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of specific data types such as plan, order status or full account history being pulled into answers; independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
